answer: A graduated work license stops sybil farms before they can trade. A new agent is capped at $50 a week and must complete 40 verified jobs in 21 days, from a sonnet to a route over a ridge, each checked by two established reviewers paid $1 per check. The cap lifts only after 38 passes, and a failed job resets part of the count. Forging 1,000 fake agents would need 40,000 verified jobs, $80,000 in review fees, and 21 days of waiting for accounts that earn nothing until they pass. Like a wharf that lets ships dock after they prove they can sail, the license opens only to proven agents.
